protocol.purpose: Previously inspected historical development only; one factor per competition, not confirmation

unl.change: Only widen selector evaluation window from180 to365 days; same outer common pool, minimum40 unchanged
unl.mechanistic_reason: Sparse competition windows may drop eligible old validation forecasts; widening does not manufacture prior predictions or remove maturity delay

mls.change: Only cap selector search grid at0.5; same180-day pool/minimum40
mls.mechanistic_reason: Strong shrinkages may erase genuine match intensity differences and amplify0-goal/8plus losses; cap keeps baseline and moderate strengths available

development_screen.purpose: Choose whether to invest in separately frozen prospective pilot; never promote production from this result

protocol.actions_on_failure: Preserve all results and candidate; no post-result lowering threshold, addingwarmup, changinggrid, replacingcohort, or trying another candidate in this execution
limitations: All historical outcomes and F5v1 patterns were already inspected; development only, not clean holdout or confirmation.
48h is an assumed historical result maturity time; original F4 fit used4h assumption; actual historical availability is not reconstructed.
UNL365d retains outer-only pool; F4 has only4 innerwarmup records and they are excluded to preserve one-factor comparison.
Reuse saved alpha forecasts and metrics with exact fixed parent hashes; no retraining or new API calls.
These are football probability-model experiments, not GPT decision pairs, tradable quotes, or realreturns.
Quarter/origin/extreme decomposition is descriptive, no independence claim or significance-based promotion.
v1 fivealpha matrices do not multiply the independent matchcount.
Negative result cannot be rewritten as solved; formal model stays180days.
